## What MHB Build Does
MHB Build, LLC is a general contractor handling residential and small-scale construction projects across Northern Kentucky. The company coordinates whole-home builds, additions, remodels, and individual specialty trades under one point of contact.

## Services
1. General Contracting — Project planning and execution from rough scope to finished detail.
2. Home Builder — New-build coordination and full-home construction services.
3. Home Improvements — Practical home upgrades, repairs, and remodeling work.
4. Roofing — Roof repair and replacement.
5. Carpentry — Interior and exterior carpentry, framing, and finish work.
6. Decorative Moldings — Crown, trim, baseboards, and architectural millwork.
7. Exterior Painting — Surface prep and painting for homes and small structures.
8. Concrete Flatwork — Driveways, patios, walkways, and pads.
9. Flooring Installation — Hardwood, engineered, and resilient flooring.
10. Tile Installation — Floor, wall, and wet-area tile.

## Process
1. Scope & Estimate — Share project details, receive a written estimate.
2. Plan & Schedule — Confirm materials, sequence, specialty trades, schedule.
3. Build — Coordinated trades, tidy worksite, clear communication.
4. Finish — Punch-list resolved, surfaces cleaned, details checked.
